name: ai-collaboration-protocol
title_zh: 开工前先立契约的 AI 协作模式开关
tagline_zh: 任务一开跑，AI 就乱改需求？这个 Skill 在动手前先让你选「探索」还是「照图施工」，把意图锁进协议里。
tagline_en: Tired of AI drifting off brief? This Skill makes you pick Explore or Build mode upfront, locking intent into a.
desc_en: Guide human–AI work through Explore or Build My Vision mode, preserving intent while granting useful autonomy. Use when starting, resetting, or governing a substantive task.
why_zh: 它把「授权」变成显式动作：先定边界再放权，AI 的每一步自由都在协议框架内，既不束手束脚，也不跑偏失控。
why_en: It turns delegation into an explicit act: set the boundary first, then grant freedom—so AI autonomy stays inside the pact.
limit_zh: 只适用于有明确起止的实质性任务；若任务本身模糊或需持续共创，它不会替你澄清目标，只会在开头多问一轮。不接闲聊或单步问答。
limit_en: Only for substantive tasks with clear start/end. Won't clarify vague goals—just adds one intake round. Not for chat or single-turn Q&A.
title_en: Set an AI collaboration pact before starting work
